messages:
maria: Drafting a PRD for a sprint that covers kernel routing choices, attention optimizations, and KV cache policy updates. Need to agree scope + acceptance criteria today. Quick sync 11:30?

jason: +1. Can we limit initial canary to two kernel variants (fast-attn + generic)? keeps risk low. :thinking_face:

kai: Prefer including quantized variants as part of canary matrix. Acceptance idea: tail latency (95/99) <= 2x current baseline and model-quality regression <= 3% on our eval suite.

devon: Edge cases to call out: short sequences (<16 tokens) must not be routed to large-batch kernels; cold KV miss path needs <10ms overhead. Also ensure KV cache warmup strategy documented.

priya: Ops note: kernel selection toggle must be operable via feature-flag per-cluster. Need rollback + hotfix plan for Dedicated nodes. Who owns infra changes?

jason: Rollback plan = feature flag + immediate fallback to generic kernel. Add tests to simulate 50% kernel failures and validate fallback latency.

maria: I'll outline the PRD sections: Scope, Acceptance Criteria, Rollout Plan (canary thresholds), Monitoring & Alerts, Rollback. Also include customer-driven asks (low-latency chat, high-throughput embed workloads).

kai: Eval harness: include prompt-suite A (dialog), B (code), C (embeddings). Metrics: latency, token-cost, NLL/accuracy deltas. Define pass/fail thresholds per model family.

devon: KV policy proposal: prefix-level KV cache for hot prefixes + TTL 24h, LRU eviction under memory pressure, and metric export of hit/miss/eviction rates. Add acceptance: hit-rate improvement >= 15% on production trace for targeted prefixes.

priya: Security: cache keys must be hashed and PII scrubbed before writing to cache; audit logs must not contain raw keys. Ops will add KMS checks.

jason: Question: do we gate rollout on model-level quality NLL delta? propose <= 0.005 absolute NLL increase on eval set.

kai: That sounds reasonable. We'll map metric by model family (gpt-like vs llama-like) and use appropriate quality metrics (NLL or task-specific).

devon: Another edge case: stale KV during canary if old kernels write different key formats. Acceptance: stale/key-compatibility incidents <= 0.1% over 24h, else auto rollback. Suggest versioned cache keys.

priya: Ops runbook items: circuit breaker for kernel errors, immediate rollback metric (error rate spike > X), contact list, and pre-run smoke tests. I'll draft these.

maria: Assignments: I'll draft PRD + rollout plan. Jason: perf matrix and failure test. Kai: eval harness and thresholds. Devon: runtime patch + compatibility test, add versioned keys. Priya: feature flags + runbook + KMS checks. Sync Friday 11:30. :calendar:

jason: SG, I'll populate perf matrix tomorrow with perf numbers from latest benchmarks.

kai: I'll add the eval suites and a small script to compute NLL/bleu diffs.

devon: I'll prototype key-versioning and a small config snippet for flagging kernels:

```
kernel_routing:
  allowlist: ["fast-attn-v1", "generic-v2"]
  fallback: "generic-v2"
  versioned_keys: true
```

priya: Nice. Will add feature-flag rollout playbook and the Dedicated cluster steps.

maria: I'll open the doc in the docs repo and share the link in this thread. @jason can you add the perf rows by EOD?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New doc created: https://internal/docs/prd/kernel-routing-1951234567 (draft)

jason: Will do. Quick q: do we also measure cost-per-token delta in acceptance criteria? propose cap <= +8% cost.

kai: Yes include cost and latency tradeoffs. Add cost-per-token cap per model family.

devon: Final ask: add canary gating: start at 1% traffic for 2h -> 5% for 4h -> 20% for 24h, with automatic rollback triggers on latency/error/quality.

priya: ack. I'll wire the automation to our rollout controller.

maria: Thanks all — draft incoming. Meeting Friday unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

jason: ack

kai: ack

devon: ack

maria: (post-meeting) Action items created in GH: #4212 PRD draft, #4213 perf matrix, #4214 runtime patch, #4215 infra flags.

priya: I'll link runbook to incident playbooks repo.

maria: Closing thread for now; reopen if anything blocks.
